name: lab
description: ML-lab rigor. experiment: the one guideline for a single experiment (fine-tune, RL, LLM eval or judge): the order of events, thirteen rules (one recorded difference between arms, prediction first, controls, noise floor, leakage, a validated instrument, the freeze, a script-written run record) each with how to meet it, the preregistration record with its tool, and the sign-off. supervisor: the door to that sign-off, where a fresh agent rules on the design before launch and on the number before it is quoted.
